headline: Anthropic to watermark Claude output under EU code
body: A quiet day. Anthropic said models released after August 2 will watermark text and files, joining other big labs under the EU AI Act Transparency Code, a small step for Global Coordination. French publishers asked the competition watchdog to act on Google's AI summaries, a push against Power Concentration that slightly lifts Libertarian Utopia. Horizon Balance edged up to -1.91.
movers_note: Enslaved God -0.1 and Libertarian Utopia +0.1 came from the French publishers' complaint (-0.09 and +0.09).
